notes: Tax Statements: total units shown beside total interest, the investor list is open by default, and columns can be sorted. New Records Consistency Check (Settings > Checks & Repair): finds a person appearing on more than one record with differing date of birth, tax number or address, and clients whose investments pay to different bank accounts; choose which is right and make them the same. Groups can be hidden as not a problem (remembered, and shown again if they change), and every change can be undone from Recent changes.
